name: Taraj Palace
observations: Cream/off-white upper frontage with three tall white-framed windows over a broad sign.
Large blue TARAJ PALACE letters on light fascia; dark-blue lower restaurant/takeaway fascia spans the bays.
Image-left opening is a substantial recessed passage with brick returns and visible depth; keep this open recess separate from the flatter window/door bay.
Lower bays have pale piers, tan brick backing, framed glazing and low black metal bars/fence.
Roof/eaves join adjacent rendered block; exposed side wall projects towards the pet-store area.
Pavement, tall lighting column, utility cabinet and planted hanging basket overlap frontage. They are separate objects.
unknowns: Exact frontage width/depth, passage terminus and behind-glass interior unknown.
Existing Blender Taraj placement was explicitly moved to the opposite side by Sam; preserve that approved gameplay placement until a calibrated reconciliation is agreed.
